segmentation.title: How the transcript is split into lines
segmentation.description: Choose what decides where one line ends and the next begins.

punctuation.label: By punctuation (recommended)
punctuation.help: The model's own punctuation decides where a line ends, and the times come from its acoustic alignment. Splits close to actual sentences, even when the speaker barely pauses.
punctuation.unavailable: Requires SenseVoice. Select it under Transcription Models to enable this.

pause.label: By pause length
pause.help: A line is a stretch of speech between two silences. Works with every engine, but in fluent speech the pause between sentences is often shorter than the threshold, so several sentences land on one line.

segmentation.pauseLengthHelpPunctuation: How long a silence must last before the audio is sent to the model. This sets how quickly text appears: nothing is transcribed until the speaker pauses this long. Lines are still split on punctuation.
segmentation.pauseLengthHelpPause: How long a silence must last before the line ends and the audio is transcribed. It sets both where lines break and how quickly text appears.
